title: Korean and Australian partners visit the plant
author: Marketing
excerpt: Two partner delegations, from Korea and Australia, spent time on the plant floor this month reviewing extrusion and finishing capacity and the main product ranges.
body: Two partner delegations visited this month, one from Korea and one from Australia. Both spent their time in the same places: the presses, the finishing lines, and the sections currently in production.

A visit of this kind is a capacity audit before it is anything else. What a distributor wants to see is not a sample board but a line running: how many presses, what circle diameter, what the finishing plant can hold on colour, and how long a repeat order takes to come round again.
Both conversations are continuing, on product development and on distribution in their markets.
